title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
claim: ai-memory — long-term memory for coding agents that survives vendor switches: quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and the architecture, failed approaches and open questions carry over. Rust, MIT.
why_good: ai-memory provides long-term memory for AI coding agents, allowing users to switch between different tools like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex without losing context on architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
value: Software development teams pay for ai-memory to maintain productivity and context during transitions between coding agents, directly addressing the inefficiencies of current multi-agent workflows.
risk: The reliance on existing coding agents like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, which may not fully support or integrate with ai-memory, poses a risk to its widespread adoption.

zh.claim: 无缝切换编码代理，保留100%的上下文。
zh.why_good: ai-memory 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，允许用户在不同工具之间切换，如 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex，而不会丢失架构、失败的方法或未解决的问题的上下文。
zh.value: 软件开发团队为 ai-memory 付费，以在编码代理之间的过渡中保持生产力和上下文，直接解决当前多代理工作流程的低效问题。
zh.risk: 对现有编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex）的依赖，可能无法完全支持或与 ai-memory 集成，这对其广泛采用构成风险。
zh.hook: 无缝切换编码代理，保留100%的上下文。
zh.does: ai-memory 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，允许用户在不同工具之间切换，如 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex，而不会丢失架构、失败的方法或未解决的问题的上下文。
zh.edge: 它独特地实现了不同 AI 编码代理之间的连续性，保留整个编码会话的上下文。
zh.why_use: 选择 ai-memory，可以避免在切换 AI 工具时重新解释复杂编码上下文的挫败感，确保更顺畅的开发过程。

does: ai-memory provides long-term memory for AI coding agents, allowing users to switch between different tools like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex without losing context on architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
edge: It uniquely enables continuity across different AI coding agents, preserving the entire context of a coding session.
why_use: Choose ai-memory to avoid the frustration of re-explaining complex coding contexts when switching between AI tools, ensuring a smoother development process.
hook: Seamlessly switch coding agents mid-task with 100% context retention.
pick_reason: The project addresses a clear need for continuity in AI coding environments, enabling users to maintain context across different tools.
